arguments.title: Investigation readout operating note
arguments.body:
The investigation framework is the standing default readout practice for Growth and Customer Success. Keep readouts lightweight and decision-focused: put the denominator and effect size before the conclusion, and treat first significance as insufficient for rollout until the result is confirmed in a stabilization cohort. Include lifecycle audience-risk review where relevant.

This practice applies to Growth and Customer Success; it is not a companywide mandate. The framework is guidance, not a required universal template. Owen maintains the standard readout shape and Ines maintains lifecycle-risk language; these ownership lanes do not require their approval of every readout and do not create a centralized approval queue.
